程序包 TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.model

类 User

java.lang.Object
TA_Recruitment_software.admin_system.model.User
public class User extends Object
Represents a user account in the TA Recruitment System.

This entity stores all user information including authentication credentials, personal details, and account status. Users can have one of three roles: Role.TA (Teaching Assistant), Role.MO (Module Organizer), or Role.ADMIN (System Administrator).

Key characteristics:

  • Each user has a unique userId generated with a role-based prefix
  • Passwords are stored as SHA-256 hashes, never in plain text
  • New registrations start with ApprovalStatus.PENDING and require admin approval
  • TA users have major, skills, and cvFilePath fields
  • MO users have department instead of major
  • Disabled users (enabled=false) cannot log in
